summary: PowerBank Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 7,000,000 common shares at ~$0.60 per share (based on $4.2M gross proceeds) to two new institutional investors. The offering is conducted under an effective F-10 shelf registration statement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as placement agent. Proceeds will fund IPP project portfolio including U.S. federal contracts, working capital, and general corporate purposes. Closing is expected on or about July 1, 2026. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation; no special category applies.
